verdict.rationale: Brex documents AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments, plus automated GL coding by entity, which covers coding and payment routing. However, there is no explicit evidence of purchase-order matching to invoices, and community feedback expresses skepticism about non-deterministic AI models being trusted for financial accuracy. Missing for 10: explicit PO-matching capability, third-party corroboration of end-to-end automated matching-coding-routing workflow, and confirmation the AI outputs are reliably accurate in production.
